highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.0 brings Skia m157 with more reliable GPU geometry, text and image filtering.
highlights_body: The stable cut adds mask-filtered glyph handling and antialiased image-subset fixes. Managed APIs remain unchanged; generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly select the native cdecl calling convention.

breaking.title: Check Graphite Metal deployment targets
breaking.body: The m157 Graphite Metal backend adopts an iOS and tvOS 15 runtime minimum; macOS remains at 12. Raise any lower application deployment targets before using this backend, and continue to honor higher managed or framework requirements.

bullets.lead: Skia m157 with existing managed bindings
bullets.detail: Moves the engine to milestone 157 without changing managed declarations. HarfBuzzSharp package revision 14.4.0.200 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 rather than introducing a new HarfBuzz engine version.

bullets.lead: Clipped paths and filtered image subsets
bullets.detail: Corrects convex antialiased path rasterization across clip gaps, coverage-mask clamping and transformed ellipse/rounded-rectangle geometry. AA and MSAA image draws keep sampling within their logical subsets under minification or strong skew, and image-filter cache equality now matches its bytewise hash.

Validates direct-mask glyph replay, rounds interpolated atlas indices and clears stale atlas work after empty flushes. Mask-filtered glyphs use their reloaded paths and formats, reject incompatible mask copies and preserve full plane strides when clipping embossed glyphs.

bullets.lead: Graphite clipping and GPU filter precision
bullets.detail: Corrects clip keys, wedge bounds and alpha-to-RGBx readback stride, and counts pending clips against render-pass capacity. Reflected zero-length hairline caps stay device-sized, and displacement offsets use fp32 arithmetic to match filter bounds.

Native synchronous submission incorporates fence-wait failures; GRContext.Submit remains void and adds no managed result. A targeted 1 ms device-loss cleanup delay applies to affected ARM proprietary driver versions from 42 up to, but not including, 56, not ordinary successful submissions.

Generated LibraryImport declarations now specify CallConvCdecl, matching the existing DllImport and callback paths. This corrects the ABI mismatch implicated in Windows x86 stack growth without changing public APIs or native exports. The reported stack-growth symptom still needs Windows x86 runtime validation.

preview_summaries.v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1: Preview 1 introduced Skia m157 with clipped-path rasterization, glyph replay and Graphite readback fixes. Generated LibraryImport declarations explicitly select cdecl; HarfBuzzSharp's new package revision still bundles HarfBuzz 14.4.0.
preview_summaries.v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6: Release Candidate 1 corrected reflected hairline square caps and GPU text-atlas selection. It also added a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers.
preview_summaries.v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19: Release Candidate 2 corrected transformed GPU geometry, stale atlas work and Graphite clip-capacity handling. Displacement offsets gained fp32 precision, and native synchronous Vulkan submission now incorporates fence-wait failures without adding a managed return value.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200 continues to bundle HarfBuzz 14.4.0 with no public-package API changes. Its generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching the existing native calling convention.

v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.headline: Preview 1 brings Skia m157 with rasterization, glyph-replay and Graphite readback fixes.
v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.body: LibraryImport declarations explicitly select cdecl. HarfBuzzSharp package revision 14.4.0.200 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0. Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15, in addition to any higher framework requirements.

v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.headline: Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline caps and GPU text-atlas selection.
v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.body: It also adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers. These fixes do not change managed APIs.

v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19.headline: Release Candidate 2 improves transformed GPU geometry, Graphite clipping and displacement-filter precision.
v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19.body: It also corrects stale Ganesh atlas work and native synchronous Vulkan wait handling. GRContext.Submit remains void; no managed failure-reporting result is added.

v4.157.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.0 improves mask-filtered text and antialiased image-subset rendering after Release Candidate 2.
v4.157.0.body: Glyph rasterization respects reloaded paths, mask formats and embossed-plane strides. Image filtering keeps samples inside logical subsets and aligns cache-key equality with hashing, without changing managed APIs.
